name: tunesfork-sync
description: Tunesfork Sync — auto-upload Ableton projects on save
author: Tunesfork

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n ui,electron -c blue,green "npm run dev:ui" "wait-on http://localhost:5180 && npm run dev"
scripts.test: node scripts/test-folder-access.cjs && node --test scripts/test-incremental-sync.cjs scripts/test-restore-validation.cjs scripts/test-sample-check.cjs scripts/test-als-delta.cjs scripts/test-als-delta-sync.cjs
scripts.dist: npm run build:ui && electron-builder && npm run verify:pack
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:ui && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --universal && npm run verify:pack
scripts.dist:mac:release: npm run build:ui && TUNESFORK_NOTARIZE=1 electron-builder --mac --universal && TUNESFORK_NOTARIZE=1 npm run verify:pack && npm run release:checksums
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:ui && electron-builder --win --x64 && npm run verify:pack

extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Tunesfork Sync needs access to the Ableton project folders you choose so it can back up saves.
extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Tunesfork Sync needs access to Ableton projects you choose from your Desktop.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Tunesfork Sync needs access when you choose an Ableton project inside Downloads.
